title: Astro Portal API v1 deletion of a space
description: DELETE /v1/space, from inside the application or from the web. See v1.md, section « Deleting a space ».

deletionRequest.description: The explicit confirmation of « Supprimer mon espace ».

deletionAccepted.description: 202: the erasure has begun and cannot be cancelled. Every session and every device of the space is detached at once; the erasure of the data completes by `completesBy`.

deleted.description: 401 of any call made afterwards with a credential of the deleted space. The application erases its copy of the space.
